filing_office: Wyoming Secretary of State, Business Division
filing_fee_notes: Base formation fee is 100; online convenience charges are additional. Annual report/license tax is the greater of 60 or 0.0002 times assets located and employed in Wyoming.
registered_agent_rules: Maintain an eligible Wyoming resident individual aged 18 or older, or a qualifying business entity, with a physical Wyoming street address. Mailbox and virtual-office addresses do not qualify.
standard_processing_time: Paper formation filings may take up to 15 business days.
expedite_options: Initial formations and annual reports that can be filed online are excluded from expedited filing service.
annual_report_due: First day of the formation anniversary month each year.
franchise_or_privilege_tax: Annual license tax equals the greater of 60 or 0.0002 times assets located and employed in Wyoming; this is the same charge listed as the annual-report fee.
state_tax_registration_agency: Wyoming Department of Revenue, Excise Tax Division
plain_english_summary: Formation costs 100. The annual report and license tax cost at least 60.
common_mistake: The annual report is due on the first day of the anniversary month.
notes: Ordinary domestic LLC. Annual report fee is the minimum, not a flat charge for every LLC, and is not an additional tax on top of the license tax. Portal URLs are official gateways. Tax-registration URL covers sales, use and lodging taxes. Publication requirement and operating-agreement mandate were not confirmed.
